lens: Adversarial — worst case, hostile fork, attacker model, missed failure mode
answer: PR #17 is a retroactive 'we already reviewed those merged PRs, here is the paperwork' drop covering #1, #2, #3, #5, #6, #7, #8, #9, #11. As paperwork it is voluminous (74 debate files + 9 synthesis + 9 audit-chain rows). Adversarially it ships five unmitigated abuse/regression surfaces. (1) AUDIT-CHAIN-FORGERY: evidence/audit-chain.jsonl is an append-only JSONL with no prev_hash / merkle root / signature — any future contributor can `git checkout origin/dev -- evidence/debate/pr-5-F3-r1.json`, rewrite the findings, re-stage, and the audit-chain row stays byte-identical because it never recorded a content hash of the cited synthesis_path. The 'reviewer_id_uniqueness_verified:true' field is self-asserted with no proof artifact. There is no `prev_event_hash` or `content_sha256` field anywhere in the 9 appended rows. (2) FIXUPTASK-REGISTRY GAP: PR body and 9 synthesis files declare 64 FixupTasks (sum of fixuptasks_recommended across the 9 audit-chain rows = 9+2+9+10+2+10+6+6+10 = 64) with stable IDs of the form F-PR<N>-NN, but the diff does NOT touch registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl — verified by absence of `+++ b/registries/` lines. Existing registry holds 133 entries, only two of which start with F-PR (F-PROVIDERFAMILY..., F-PROJECTED...), neither matching the F-PR<N>-NN pattern. Result: 64 high-/major-severity blockers are 'recommended' in evidence but UNFILED in the canonical registry; the doctrine requirement to be tracked is silently violated and downstream gates cannot block on them. F2 already independently surfaced this — it is a hard gap, not a stylistic concern. (3) POST-MERGE PRECEDENT ATTACK: This PR establishes 'consensus_debate_complete' for nine PRs AFTER they were merged into dev. The doctrine intent of multispectrum-review is to gate merges; retroactive paperwork inverts the control. A bad-faith or schedule-pressured future agent can cite PR #17 as precedent: 'we merged PR-X without consensus debate; we will append the debate evidence in a later PR.' Once the precedent stands, the pre-merge gate is decorative. Nothing in the PR body acknowledges this inversion or constrains future use. (4) SCHEMA-DIVERGENCE / SHAPE-DRIFT: PR #17's pr-*-Fn-r1.json files use a stripped shape (24-42 lines, simple `findings[]` with severity/file/issue/remediation) that diverges from the canonical CC-2 r1 shape demonstrated by pr-12-F3-r1.json on this same branch (key_claims[], uncertainty_areas[], attack_scenarios[], facet_id, change_class, lens). F5 also flagged this. Adversarial impact: doctrine consumers (jq scripts, validators, future synthesis tooling) keyed on the richer shape will silently skip pr-17 evidence files, treating them as 'not multispectrum' — the paperwork passes humans but fails machines. The PR validation report says only `jq empty` was run, which is the weakest possible schema check (parseable != conformant). (5) RE-WRITE / BACKDATE ATTACK: There is no commitment that pr-*-r1.json files are immutable once landed. A future contributor with write access to evidence/debate/ can `git mv` or in-place edit pr-5-F3-r1.json, soften the 10 high-severity blockers, force-push (or land via normal PR), and audit-chain row for pr-5 still passes integrity check because it never bound to content. Combined with (1), this means the 'permanent record' is editable in place. (6) RECONCILIATION GAP: synthesis_path field in each audit-chain row is a relative repo path — if a future cleanup PR mv's evidence/debate/ to evidence/debate-archive/2026/ (or simply deletes the files under markdown-retirement policy), the audit-chain row becomes a dangling reference with no integrity check to detect the break.
key_claims: audit-chain.jsonl rows for pr-1..pr-11 contain no prev_hash, no content_sha256, and no signature — chain is append-only text, not cryptographically chained; integrity proof is absent

PR diff does NOT modify registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl (verified by grep on `+++ b/registries` in pr-17.diff returning empty); 64 declared FixupTasks (F-PR<N>-NN) are silently unfiled in the canonical registry
pr-17 emits 9 retroactive 'consensus_debate_complete' events for already-merged PRs, establishing a precedent that gates can be filed after the merge they were supposed to block

pr-17 evidence-file shape (24-42 line round files) diverges from canonical CC-2 multispectrum r1 shape on the same branch (pr-12-F3-r1.json is 71 lines with key_claims/uncertainty_areas/attack_scenarios); machine consumers may silently drop pr-17 evidence
evidence/debate/pr-*-*.json files have no immutability marker, no content hash binding, no pre-commit/CI lane preventing in-place edit — combined with (1), the 'record' is editable in place
audit-chain synthesis_path is a bare relative repo path with no integrity binding; a future move/delete silently breaks the reference
uncertainty_areas: Whether a separate follow-up PR in the queue files the 64 F-PR<N>-NN tasks into registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl (not in PR #17 itself)
Whether downstream doctrine tooling actually consumes pr-*-Fn-r1.json shape or only synthesis files (impact of shape drift depends on consumer set)
Whether the project intentionally separates 'review evidence' from 'fixup tracking' such that registry filing is a deliberately distinct PR (no ADR cited if so)
Whether ADR-0064 / multispectrum-review v2.3.0 spec authorizes retroactive 'consensus_debate_complete' events for merged PRs
attack_scenarios: Audit-rewrite: future contributor edits evidence/debate/pr-5-F3-r1.json to soften the 10 HIGH blockers, lands it via normal PR — audit-chain row for pr-5 stays valid because it never bound content; the historical record is now whatever the most recent edit says.
Registry-bypass: 64 declared FixupTasks never get filed; downstream blocking gates that read registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl never trip; the 'blocking_fixups' verdict is paperwork-only.

Post-merge-debate precedent: future agent merges hot PR-X under deadline pressure, then cites PR #17 as precedent for 'we'll file the multispectrum evidence in a follow-up' — pre-merge gate becomes optional.

Schema-drift silencing: validator/jq scripts keyed on key_claims/uncertainty_areas treat pr-17 r1 files as malformed and skip them; pr-17's verdicts disappear from aggregated dashboards without anyone noticing.

Reference-rot: doc-retirement PR removes evidence/debate/pr-5-synthesis.json under markdown-retirement-policy; audit-chain row for pr-5 now points at /dev/null; no integrity check fails because there is none.

Hostile-fork mining: attacker forks repo, mines the 74 debate files for internal reviewer-ID patterns, session-IDs (codex-multispectrum-review-9-prs-2026-05-16), and findings catalog to map weak spots in production code already merged.

findings.summary: Audit-chain is append-only text with no prev_hash / content_sha256 / signature. 'Audit chain' is a misnomer — there is no chain. Combined with editable evidence files, the historical multispectrum record can be silently rewritten.
findings.recommended_action: Add `prev_event_hash` (sha256 of canonical-JSON of prior row) and `payload_content_sha256` (sha256 of the cited synthesis_path file at commit-time) to every consensus_debate_complete row. Backfill for pr-1..pr-11 in a follow-up PR. Add a CI lane that re-derives both hashes and fails on mismatch. Without this, the audit-chain provides no integrity proof, only narrative.

findings.summary: 64 declared FixupTasks (F-PR<N>-NN) are NOT filed in registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl. PR diff does not touch the registry. Downstream blocking gates cannot enforce what is not registered.
findings.recommended_action: Either (a) include the 64 F-PR<N>-NN rows in registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl in this same PR, or (b) open the registry-filing PR atomically with PR #17 and block merge of #17 until it lands. Add a CI lane that scans `fixuptask_id` strings in evidence/debate/**/*.json and fails if any referenced ID is missing from the registry. Currently the 'ACCEPT_WITH_BLOCKING_FIXUPS' verdict is unenforceable.

findings.summary: Retroactive consensus_debate_complete events for already-merged PRs invert the pre-merge gate doctrine and set a precedent that paperwork can follow merges instead of blocking them.
findings.recommended_action: Amend the PR body (and add a clarifying ADR) explicitly scoping PR #17 as a one-shot historical-backfill for pre-doctrine merges, declaring 'post-merge consensus debate is NOT a valid pattern for future PRs', and adding a CI lane that fails when a consensus_debate_complete event's `timestamp_unix` is later than the corresponding PR merge commit timestamp without an explicit `backfill_authorization` ADR reference.

findings.summary: PR #17 evidence-file shape (24-42 line round files with `severity/file/issue/remediation`) diverges from canonical CC-2 multispectrum r1 shape on the same branch (pr-12-F3-r1.json: key_claims, uncertainty_areas, attack_scenarios, change_class, lens). Validation used only `jq empty` which catches parse errors but not schema conformance.
findings.recommended_action: Publish a JSON schema for evidence/debate/pr-*-Fn-r*.json (and pr-*-synthesis.json) under docs/schemas/multispectrum/, add a CI lane that validates every file in evidence/debate/ against the schema, and either (a) normalize pr-17 files to the richer canonical shape, or (b) document the slim shape as a sanctioned 'retroactive-backfill' variant in the schema.

findings.summary: Evidence files under evidence/debate/ have no immutability marker, no content-hash binding, and no CI lane preventing in-place rewrite. Combined with finding-01, historical review records can be edited after the fact and the audit-chain will not detect it.
findings.recommended_action: Add a CI lane that, for any modification of an existing evidence/debate/pr-*-Fn-r1.json or pr-*-synthesis.json file, requires either (a) a referenced superseding-event row in evidence/audit-chain.jsonl, or (b) an ADR sanctioning the edit. Default policy: append a `pr-<N>-Fn-r2.json` (or higher round) instead of editing r1 in place. Reject silent edits.

findings.summary: audit-chain synthesis_path is a bare relative repo path with no integrity binding. A future doc-retirement or rename PR silently breaks the reference and no check detects the dangling pointer.
findings.recommended_action: When implementing finding-01 (content hashing), also pin `synthesis_path` with `synthesis_path_sha256`. Add a CI lane that resolves every synthesis_path in evidence/audit-chain.jsonl and fails on missing file or hash mismatch.
